source_evidence: the investor can have the dividends or distributions reinvested in the mutual fund to buy more shares.
question: Misconception: Reinvesting a mutual fund distribution means the fund transfers the amount to me as cash, rather than using it to buy more shares.
answer: Correction: Investors can choose to have dividends or capital-gains distributions reinvested in the mutual fund to buy more shares, instead of having the amount transferred to them.
